# dead-code-finder

> Find dead Python code with ast across a set of modules: unused imports, functions, classes and methods, plus unreachable statements, with confidence scores Python package `trysac-dead-code-finder`, import name `dead_code_finder`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
